scope: Combined NeoCalculator architecture, official-renderer Huawei integration, all billing modes and conservative memory cleanup, ready to merge into main.

nativeLifecycleChecks: An active session survives sweeping and refreshes correctly
An empty pool releases contexts while keeping Chromium warm
Saved selections replay and price correctly after common assets are released
Expired save requests promptly release their browser context
Expiry checks and sweeping leave an in-flight edit intact
Finished expired work is cleaned up by the next save request
Rejected opens leak no contexts and do not prevent the next valid open
Explicit shutdown closes the shared browser

fixtureRepairs: NAT/EIP expected catalog objects now include the constraints already added to their schemas. Only assertions changed; production pricing code is unchanged.
limits: Initial native calculator open took 7–11 seconds in this sample; edits took about 1.7–1.8 seconds. These are samples, not a latency guarantee.
The native pool admits at most six sessions.
Upstream Huawei availability and supported widget formats remain dependencies. Unknown formats block quoting rather than guessing.
Coverage does not establish exhaustive support for every service/flavor/region combination.
